lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 122, for issue 120: Up, Down, Home and End select the file at the cursor after a blank-space click.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one twenty-two, for issue one twenty: Up, Down, Home and End select the file at the cursor after a blank-space click.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
One new rule in the key handler every view shares: with nothing selected, these keys select the file at the cursor.
You press Up, Down, Home or End, with no Shift or Ctrl, while nothing is selected.
lines.say: You press Up, Down, Home or End, with no shift or control, while nothing is selected.

lines.caption: The shared key handler, connected to every view, notices that case. Every other key goes on as before.
It lets the view handle the key first. Where the cursor can move, the view moves it and selects the new row.
If still nothing is selected, a new helper selects the file at the cursor, and the key stops there.
In the details view with Expandable Folders on, the details view's own handler runs first and takes Up and Down.
On the first or last row its cursor can't move, which is unchanged.
So after a plain Up or Down, it now calls the same helper, and the file at the cursor is selected.
Before, after a blank-space click, Up on the first file or Down on the last selected nothing. PgUp and PgDn always did.
lines.say: Before, after a blank-space click, Up on the first file or Down on the last selected nothing. Page up and page down always did.

lines.caption: The cursor and the selection are separate. GTK only selects a row when the cursor moves, so at the edge these keys did nothing.
lines.say: The cursor and the selection are separate. G T K only selects a row when the cursor moves, so at the edge these keys did nothing.

lines.caption: The details view's handler does run first, so it calls the same helper, which checks the keyboard focus itself.
The shared handler serves the details, icon and compact views, but only while the file view itself has the keyboard focus.
The helper acts only while the file view has the focus, and selects only a row holding a file, never a Loading placeholder.
Home and End still go through the shared handler in the details view, even with Expandable Folders on.
The helper's own focus check covers this path too. Shift and Ctrl with Up or Down keep their selection code from PR 51.
lines.say: The helper's own focus check covers this path too. Shift and control with Up or Down keep their selection code from pull request fifty-one.

lines.caption: On the first file, the last file, or the only file, the key now selects it instead of nothing.
Keys that can move, PgUp and PgDn, Shift and Ctrl, a selection, or a focused column header behave as before.
lines.say: Keys that can move, page up and page down, shift and control, a selection, or a focused column header behave as before.

lines.caption: One small change: Home and End in an empty folder now stop at the view, with nothing to scroll.
This is the new rule: if the view has the focus, run its own handler, select the cursor's file if needed, and stop the key.
The helper checks the focus too, so the details view's own Up and Down path gets the same check.
The PR changes three source files, adds a test with 40 checks, and adds this page and its narration.
lines.say: The PR changes three source files, adds a test with forty checks, and adds this page and its narration.

lines.caption: To undo it, revert this PR. It adds no setting.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
The building session ran every test twice in a container. CI reviewed the PR three times; its third review's 5 small points are accepted.
lines.say: The building session ran every test twice in a container. C I reviewed the pull request three times; its third review's five small points are accepted.

lines.caption: The test runs each case from the issue, and the four keys now copy what PgUp and PgDn already did.
lines.say: The test runs each case from the issue, and the four keys now copy what page up and page down already did.

lines.caption: Each check copies the selection and pastes it; a pasted sentinel file, copied beforehand when needed, means nothing was selected.
The first commit built, with four old doc warnings elsewhere, and all 21 tests passed.
lines.say: The first commit built, with four old doc warnings elsewhere, and all twenty-one tests passed.

lines.caption: After the review fixes, it built again with no warnings in changed files, and all 21 tests passed again.
lines.say: After the review fixes, it built again with no warnings in changed files, and all twenty-one tests passed again.

lines.caption: Before CI's fix to the test, it passed every check in all three views, and the Shift and Ctrl test still passed.
lines.say: Before C I's fix to the test, it passed every check in all three views, and the shift and control test still passed.

lines.caption: Not run: the old build, the keypad keys, a folder still loading, and an empty folder.
On CI's fix commit, the build passed and all 21 tests passed, including the stricter new test.
lines.say: On C I's fix commit, the build passed and all twenty-one tests passed, including the stricter new test.

lines.caption: An independent agent audited all 9 screenshots from that run, and every one showed what it claims.
lines.say: An independent agent audited all nine screenshots from that run, and every one showed what it claims.

lines.caption: After CI's second review, it built and all 21 tests passed, but the new test took 95 seconds, too near its limit.
lines.say: After C I's second review, it built and all twenty-one tests passed, but the new test took ninety-five seconds, too near its limit.

lines.caption: With shorter waits, the new test passed twice on its own, in 65 seconds, with all 40 checks.
lines.say: With shorter waits, the new test passed twice on its own, in sixty-five seconds, with all forty checks.

lines.caption: On CI's second fix, before the last test change, the build passed and all 21 tests passed, the new test in 85 seconds.
lines.say: On C I's second fix, before the last test change, the build passed and all twenty-one tests passed, the new test in eighty-five seconds.

lines.caption: On the push with the last test change, CI's build passed and its review ran; its tests were still running when this page was written.
lines.say: On the push with the last test change, C I's build passed and its review ran; its tests were still running when this page was written.

lines.caption: CI's run on this push, which changes only this page, comes after it was written; its review skips it.
lines.say: C I's run on this push, which changes only this page, comes after it was written; its review skips it.

lines.caption: Before the first push, a fresh review agent found 9 problems: 4 are fixed, and 5 are accepted.
lines.say: Before the first push, a fresh review agent found nine problems: four are fixed, and five are accepted.

lines.caption: Loading rows are never selected, the test keeps its window focused, and it now covers the compact view.
The accepted five would mean a redesign, cost little, match existing code, or were there before this PR.
CI's own review of the PR found 7 problems. It fixed 3 in its own commit, and the owner accepted the other 4.
lines.say: C I's own review of the pull request found seven problems. It fixed three in its own commit, and the owner accepted the other four.

lines.caption: The test now proves each check with a sentinel file, and checks that a blank-space click really clears the selection.
The new rule now needs the file view to have the keyboard focus, so a focused column header keeps its keys.
Other keys at a view's edge, like Left and Right, are outside issue 120, so the owner left them as they are.
lines.say: Other keys at a view's edge, like Left and Right, are outside issue one twenty, so the owner left them as they are.

lines.caption: The rest cost little, cover separate cases, or leave the test 34 seconds under its time limit.
lines.say: The rest cost little, cover separate cases, or leave the test thirty-four seconds under its time limit.

lines.caption: CI's second review found 6 more problems. CI fixed 2, the building session fixed 2, and 2 low ones are accepted.
lines.say: C I's second review found six more problems. C I fixed two, the building session fixed two, and two low ones are accepted.

lines.caption: The focus check now sits in the helper itself, so the details view's own Up and Down path checks the focus too.
The test now checks every blank-space click, and copies the sentinel only when the clipboard may hold another file.
The sentinel is in effect, since the first check needs it, and the test now has 55 seconds to spare.
lines.say: The sentinel is in effect, since the first check needs it, and the test now has fifty-five seconds to spare.

lines.caption: CI's third review found R10 and R13 fixed, and 5 more problems, all low and not confirmed, so all 5 are accepted.
lines.say: C I's third review found R ten and R thirteen fixed, and five more problems, all low and not confirmed, so all five are accepted.

lines.caption: A shorter wait after a paste is safe: the check polls until the names appear, and two runs passed.
The helper's check order changes nothing, and both focus checks are needed, one for each path.
An extra refocus in the test costs milliseconds, and the helper's name is a naming point only.
Real folders, a real keyboard and the keypad keys are only tried once the owner installs the next build.
The PR, its changes, CI's screenshots, the issue, CI's runs and the screenshot audit are all linked here.
Part 3. What comes later.
No open issue depends on this one yet. A later fix to cursor movement can reuse the new helper.
In short: after a blank-space click, Up, Down, Home and End always select the file at the cursor.
